what.text: This page follows refugees from Djibouti in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 2223 refugees from Djibouti, and France hosted 54.3% of them.
After France, the largest hosts are the United States, Belgium and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Djibouti with FRUD from 1991 to 1994 and in 1999.
It also records an interstate armed conflict between Djibouti and Eritrea in 2008.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1990 at 5 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 18096, at the end of 1996.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1994 to 1996, and the figure has fallen since then.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
